name: Ample and Resolution-Slope Equivalence
hypotheses: Finite nonempty binary family over any coefficient field $k$.
statement: Shattering extremality is equivalent to a linear resolution of the literal ideal, hence to $\lambda_k=1$ and to $\nu_k=0$.
proof: Every positive-step shift of a minimally generated degree-$n$ ideal is at least $n+i$, so slope one is equivalent to a linear resolution and to zero rounded defect. The Alexander-dual Yang correspondence identifies linear resolution of $J_C$ with ampleness.
